destination.title: Compactifications, effective actions and vacua
destination.question: How do specified higher-dimensional constructions yield lower-dimensional effective physics, and under what control conditions can their vacua, potentials and phenomenological consequences be interpreted?
destination.summary: Keep effective-action derivation, consistent truncation, solution lifting, vacuum construction and phenomenology as separate targets.

targets: Flavor, light moduli and cosmological applications
regimes: Low energies relative to relevant compactification excitations
assumptions: Differential closure alone does not prove low-energy validity
Volume, coupling, quantization and source data must be assessed where relevant
Imposed Swampland criteria are not derived consequences
conventions: Phenomenological applications and construction statistics are alternate or overlapping targets
excludes: Universal control inferred from a finite reduction
A full nonperturbative definition inferred from a low-energy review

sources.title: Local SU(5) Unification from the Heterotic String

evidence.text: Can local FI sources and the full supergravity fields support an N = 1 background with two dimensions much larger than the string scale? Can an isotropic supersymmetric vacuum be obtained as a limit?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: How can ten- or eleven-dimensional theories yield four-dimensional gauge and gravitational physics?

sources.title: Further refining the de Sitter swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can explicit positive-potential supergravity points constrain conjectured quantum-gravity bounds? The paper uses classical type IIA data while tracking whether volume, coupling, flux quantization and source multiplicity permit a reliable string interpretation.

sources.title: Anatomy of a top-down approach to discrete and modular flavor symmetry

evidence.text: How does a heterotic string construction determine the complete flavor symmetry and its breaking, and which restrictions might this impose on bottom-up discrete and modular flavor models?

sources.title: Symmetry points of $ \mathcal{N}=1 $ modular geometry

evidence.text: How far can modular symmetry alone identify critical points and generically classify their vacuum energy in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity, while constraining weak-coupling potential asymptotics through metric positivity and imposed Swampland criteria?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking with fields, strings and branes

evidence.text: How do supersymmetry-breaking mechanisms connect four-dimensional field theory and supergravity to string constructions, and what can tadpole-deformed backgrounds establish about vacuum stability and the onset of inflation?

sources.title: $G_2$ flux compactifications

evidence.text: How can three-dimensional N=1 effective actions for the five ten-dimensional string theories be organized on general G2 geometries, including two-form sectors, axions, vectors, geometric flux and real superpotentials?

sources.title: Model independent properties and cosmological implications of the dilaton and moduli sectors of 4-d strings

evidence.text: Under which assumptions do four-dimensional string dilaton/moduli multiplets remain light after SUSY breaking, and what cosmological constraints and possible uses follow for their scalar and fermionic components?

sources.title: String universality

evidence.text: Can the five perturbative string theories and 11D supergravity share a central domain with identical 4D low energy physics, and can duality-related boundary descriptions constrain moduli stabilization, supersymmetry breaking, and phenomenology there?

sources.title: Hyperbolic space forms and orbifold compactification in M-theory

evidence.text: Which string and supergravity backgrounds can contain real hyperbolic factors or finite-volume discrete quotients, and when do Killing spinors, finite flux and possible holographic interpretations survive the quotient construction?

sources.title: Statistics on the heterotic landscape: Gauge groups and cosmological constants of four-dimensional heterotic strings

evidence.text: Which gauge groups and one-loop vacuum amplitudes occur in a random sample of four-dimensional heterotic strings, and what correlations reflect underlying string consistency constraints?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Why did a consistent N = 4 gauged-supergravity truncation with a supersymmetric AdS4 vacuum lack a ten-dimensional interpretation using only conventional fluxes and D6/O6 sources?

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: What shared lower-dimensional structure permits comparison of the four ten-dimensional theories? Toroidal reduction gives a common orthogonal scalar coset and generic Abelian gauge fields, allowing the paper to compare duality identifications and charged classical solutions.

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Can consistent supersymmetric Kaluza–Klein truncations retain the massive breathing-mode multiplet alongside the massless graviton multiplet, and can the resulting lower-dimensional theories generate exact higher-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIB supergravity on general squashed Sasaki–Einstein five-manifolds admit a finite, nonlinear, consistent truncation retaining the massive KK states dual to the universal gauge sector?

sources.title: Duality orbits of non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: Which duality-inequivalent gauging orbits admit a geometric higher-dimensional origin, and can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reductions of double field theory realize genuinely non-geometric orbits?

sources.title: On \alpha' corrections in N=1 F-theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which corrections to four-dimensional N=1 F-theory effective actions follow from classical reduction of the known purely gravitational eleven-dimensional R^4 terms, survive the F-theory limit, and admit a weakly coupled Type IIB interpretation?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Which matter representations occupy the largest-dimensional branches of six-dimensional supergravity for a specified gauge group?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: How does the finite Wilson-line order determine the complementary lattice and right-moving momentum quantization at circle maximal enhancement?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Can varying E beyond the original E1 and E2 choices realize 6A3 while keeping shift-generated Wilson lines fixed?

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent truncations around eleven-dimensional AdS₅ vacua preserving 16 supercharges yield five-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity with vector multiplets, and what restricts their matter content and gaugings?

sources.title: The higher-dimensional origin of five-dimensional $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Which five-dimensional N=2 matter contents, scalar manifolds and gaugings are algebraically compatible with consistent truncations of higher-dimensional supergravity?

sources.title: Unifying the 6D $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1, 1) string landscape

evidence.text: What connected components and nonabelian gauge enhancements can occur in six-dimensional N=(1,1) string vacua, and can rank reduction organize all known components and predict additional ones?

sources.title: Consistent truncations and dualities

evidence.text: Do generalised T-dualities and consistent truncations in generalised geometry correspond one-to-one? The paper establishes the direction from generalised cosets to consistent truncations and investigates what obstructs the converse.

sources.title: Compactification on Calabi-Yau threefolds: consistent truncation to pure supergravity

evidence.text: Can compactification on an arbitrary Calabi–Yau threefold yield an explicit consistent truncation to pure supergravity with eight supercharges, so that every lower-dimensional solution uplifts, including the full nonlinear fermionic theory?

sources.title: String islands, discrete theta angles and the 6D $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1) string landscape

evidence.text: Classify six-dimensional N=(1,1) asymmetric orbifolds with chiral gravitini, construct the missing type II string islands, and determine how discrete theta angles affect string and particle charges.

sources.title: Dimensional reduction of the M-theory Chern-Simons term at order <math display="inline"><msubsup><mo>ℓ</mo><mi>p</mi><mn>6</mn></msubsup></math>

evidence.text: What is the complete circle reduction of the eight-derivative M-theory Chern–Simons term, including gauge-invariant RR/NS-NS couplings beyond BR⁴, and does its selected six-dimensional reduction satisfy heterotic/type IIA S-duality?

sources.title: Fiber bundles and generalized dimensional reduction

evidence.text: How do global symmetries enable consistent generalized reductions of eleven- and ten-dimensional supergravities, and what restrictions do global geometry and topology impose on the compactification and resulting masses?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Uplift the source system, retain its assumed geometrical Bianchi identity, and change the reduction circle. Map both curvature and signed sources to identify the resulting ten-dimensional RR identity and compare consistency conditions.

sources.title: Local SU(5) Unification from the Heterotic String

evidence.text: Enumerate candidate states, impose sector-specific mass and phase conditions, intersect surviving gauge roots, and group states into supersymmetry multiplets. Equivalent fixed points supply multiplicities; inequivalent Wilson-line embeddings supply distinct charges.

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: Shift the seed's asymptotic radius above one, rotate its charge into a ten-dimensional gauge U(1), and rescale the final internal modulus. This isolates a finite Wilson-line-zero locus outside the repulson without relying on geometric self-duality there.

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Extract masses from quadratic fluctuations around the AdS vacuum and infer dual operator dimensions. For weak G2 reductions, identify an N=1 scalar description using φ=e^v+ih and K=−7 log(φ+φ̄).

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Expand fields in the globally defined structure forms η, J and Ω, whose algebra closes under exterior differentiation and Hodge duality. Substitution into ten-dimensional equations removes internal-coordinate dependence, providing the authors' consistency argument.

sources.title: Duality orbits of non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: Gauge closure and bracket antisymmetry determine quadratic constraints. Polynomial solutions are obtained using the Gianni–Trager–Zacharias primary-decomposition algorithm in Singular, then grouped under duality transformations.

sources.title: Hyperbolic spaces in string and M theory

evidence.text: Which string and eleven-dimensional supergravity backgrounds can contain negatively curved symmetric spaces or finite-volume hyperbolic quotients, and what do these constructions imply for supersymmetry, dimensional reduction, gravitational potentials and candidate holographic conformal theories?

sources.title: Wormholes in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Can covering-space supergravity saddles be interpreted in a string theory whose scalar space is an arithmetic quotient? The paper uses exact discrete gauge symmetry, rather than the broken continuous classical isometry, as the constraint on such an interpretation.

sources.title: Gauged D=9 supergravities and Scherk-Schwarz reduction

evidence.text: Which inequivalent nine-dimensional gauged theories arise from twisted circle reductions of IIB supergravity and string theory, and how do monodromy conjugacy classes determine their gaugings and allowed parameters?

sources.title: Seeking the Loop Quantum Gravity Barbero-Immirzi Parameter and Field in 4D, N = 1 Supergravity

evidence.text: Can the constant and dynamical Barbero–Immirzi coupling be embedded in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity, and does its supersymmetric completion support an axion interpretation suggesting overlap with string effective theory?

sources.title: D term strings

evidence.text: Which local magnetic cosmic strings preserve supersymmetry in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity, how does their gravitational BPS bound work, and could these solitons describe effective D-strings from wrapped D-branes?

sources.title: String dualities and modular symmetries in supergravity: a review

evidence.text: How do modular symmetries supplement four-dimensional N=1 and N=2 supergravity to constrain effective couplings, expose nonperturbative dualities, and encode quantum-gravity information such as the moduli-dependent species scale?

sources.title: Fine Tuning, Sequestering, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can multiple conformal points remain independently tunable in one compact gravitational theory? The orbifold construction supplies 27 local sectors and Coulomb parameters that can all be set to zero independently.

sources.title: Three-forms, dualities and membranes in four-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: How can four-dimensional N=1 supergravity with double three-form multiplets accommodate symplectic dualities, membranes with arbitrary electric-magnetic charges, and back-reacted BPS domain walls connecting different flux vacua?

sources.title: A Note on Membrane Interactions and the Scalar potential

evidence.text: Can a membrane interaction dictionary convert restrictions on quantum-gravity spectra into restrictions on scalar potentials, and can the construction extend beyond four-dimensional N=1 supergravity?

sources.title: The landscape and the swampland of O(3,3) gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Which seven-dimensional half-maximal O(3,3) gaugings admit exact type II freely acting orbifold realizations, and how do string consistency conditions restrict their continuous gauging parameters?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an alternative supergravity formulation remain regular at zero c_s² or zero coupled-field determinant, and can it arise as a low-energy limit of string theory?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can strongly nonsupersymmetric string constructions invalidate the proposed bound? The paper uses them as preliminary tests while retaining their instabilities and distinguishing misaligned from fully restored supersymmetry.

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Does a finite reduction capture low-energy states, lift every solution, or satisfy a supergravity construction? The source treats these as distinct questions; differential closure alone is not a physical low-energy proof.

sources.title: The Moduli space and M(atrix) theory of 9d N=1 backgrounds of M/string theory

evidence.text: Determine the moduli-space components, weakly coupled limits and DLCQ M(atrix) descriptions of reduced-rank nine-dimensional M/string backgrounds preserving 16 supercharges.

sources.title: Three-forms and Fayet-Iliopoulos terms in Supergravity: Scanning Planck mass and BPS domain walls

evidence.text: Can a three-form embedded in a vector multiplet dynamically generate the supergravity Planck scale, admit a Fayet–Iliopoulos dual description, and support membrane domain walls across which the effective Planck mass changes?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional quantum-gravity theory have an exactly vanishing N = 1 superpotential, or no N = 2 prepotential instanton corrections, when its realized supersymmetry permits those contributions?

destination.title: Amplitudes, higher derivatives and consistency
destination.question: What do supersymmetry, duality, factorization, analyticity and unitarity imply for specified amplitudes, higher-derivative interactions and double-copy constructions?
destination.summary: Distinguish constructing amplitudes, testing counterterms, bounding coefficients, extending ansätze and extracting arithmetic inequalities.

evidence.text: The paper tests compatibility between curvature interactions inherited from compactified strings and supersymmetry of the four-dimensional massless theory.

sources.title: One loop superstring effective actions and N=8 supergravity

evidence.text: Does the same-chirality Weyl quartic required by the reported compactified-string actions admit an N=8 completion within the massless supergravity multiplet, possibly with scalar couplings and corrected transformations?

sources.title: Superstring amplitudes, unitarily, and Hankel determinants of multiple zeta values

evidence.text: What positivity inequalities on polynomials of zeta values and multiple zeta values follow from unitarity and analyticity of four-particle open- and closed-superstring tree amplitudes?

sources.title: Generalizations of the double-copy: the KLT bootstrap

evidence.text: Which generalized tree-level KLT kernels define local double-copy maps, which single-copy theories satisfy their constraints, and which output theories can they produce?

sources.title: On extended supersymmetry of 4d Galileons and 3-brane effective actions

evidence.text: Can asymmetric brane boundaries reproduce the quintic amplitude patterns and their free parameters? Can massive-gravity limits explain the forced gravity couplings, and do N=2 hypermultiplets admit Galileons outside the vector-multiplet classification?

sources.title: Stringy Completions of the Standard Model from the Bottom Up

evidence.text: Do the allowed four-point ansätze remain consistent when their inferred massive states scatter, at higher multiplicity, or under alternative string-like dressings?

sources.title: Saturating unitarity bounds at U-duality symmetric points

evidence.text: Where do the leading four-graviton Wilson coefficients of toroidally compactified type II string theory attain their minima in D=6,7,8, and can these values guide future tests of sharp unitarity bounds for maximally supersymmetric quantum gravity?

sources.title: Bootstrapping string theory EFT

evidence.text: How tightly do four-point monodromy relations and unitarity constrain open-string EFT coefficients, spacetime dimension and spectra, with or without supersymmetry and tachyons? What closed-string regions follow through KLT?

sources.title: String theory from maximal supersymmetry

evidence.text: How strongly do maximal supersymmetry, unbroken R-symmetry, higher-point tree factorization, and a six-scalar parity condition constrain four-point EFT Wilson coefficients? With additional dispersive positivity assumptions, do those constraints isolate the open-superstring Veneziano amplitude?

sources.title: Where is tree-level heterotic string theory?

evidence.text: Which string-like structures follow from four-point tree-level consistency in ten-dimensional half-maximal supersymmetry, and where do heterotic amplitudes lie relative to the resulting EFT bounds?

sources.title: One loop superstring effective actions and N=8 supergravity

evidence.text: Substitute g_s=e^{4φ/(d−2)}g_E, transform measure and contractions, and retain derivative terms appropriate to the requested output.

sources.title: Superstring amplitudes, unitarily, and Hankel determinants of multiple zeta values

evidence.text: Euler beta-function integrals generate the open-string pole sum. Splitting the closed-string worldsheet integration into |w|≤1 and |w|≥1 isolates s- and u-channel contributions; expansion of gamma-function residues produces the zeta combinations.

sources.title: Generalizations of the double-copy: the KLT bootstrap

evidence.text: Invert nonsingular Rn × Rn submatrices of mn to construct the kernel. Schur-complement determinants convert the self-copy identity into a matrix-rank condition; left and right null vectors encode generalized KKBCJ constraints.

sources.title: On extended supersymmetry of 4d Galileons and 3-brane effective actions

evidence.text: Match a low-energy forward pole to a positive cross-section integral through contour deformation. The operation tests a necessary UV-completion condition and is applied here to distinguish pure Galileons from DBI-protected Galileons.

sources.title: Stringy Completions of the Standard Model from the Bottom Up

evidence.text: Match pole and zero sets so crossed-channel singularities cancel in residues, then choose equally spaced towers; positivity remains an independent test.

sources.title: Saturating unitarity bounds at U-duality symmetric points

evidence.text: Uses Poisson summation and Fourier-Bessel expansions for numerical surface scans. In D=8, matches the one-loop string amplitude to a dimensionally regularized supergravity box integral to fix the finite subtraction convention.

sources.title: One loop superstring effective actions and N=8 supergravity

evidence.text: Can pure four-dimensional N=8 supergravity be separated from states and interactions required by its proposed string origin?

sources.title: Arguments Against a Finite N=8 Supergravity

evidence.text: Can an all-orders finite, SU(8)-covariant perturbative S-matrix for N = 8 supergravity describe a quantum-gravitational theory containing charged BPS states, given their proposed production amplitudes and dispersion-theoretic contributions at low energy?

sources.title: Stringy KLT relations, global symmetries, and $E_{7(7)}$ violation

evidence.text: How do stringy KLT relations organize SU(8)-violating massless amplitudes, and, after isolating the SU(8)-invariant R4 completion, do its single-soft scalar limits satisfy the continuous E7(7) requirement for an N=8 supergravity counterterm?

sources.title: Reggeization of N=8 supergravity and N=4 Yang-Mills theory. II.

evidence.text: Could singularities generated by perturbative gravitational graph sums encode the nonperturbative light states expected in a string-theory decoupling limit? The proposed connection is intended to bear on whether N=8 supergravity can stand as a complete quantum gravity.

sources.title: Spin-four $ \mathcal{N}=7 $ W-supergravity: S-fold and double copy construction

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional theory with 28 supercharges exist beyond conventional massless supergravity, using massive Weyl-multiplet double copies and nonperturbative string S-folds?
